name: Emaar Properties
description: One of the pioneer real estate developers in Dubai, Emaar Properties has established itself as a symbol of prestige and luxury. Since 1997, the brand has delivered exceptional services and an unparalleled lifestyle to its valued customers. Emaar has a diverse portfolio of exclusive residential communities, prestigious commercial complexes and massive retail destinations. Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Fountain are the brand's most iconic creations. Emaar's projects have contributed significantly to Dubai's economic growth and have played a crucial role in establishing the city as a global business and tourism hub.

name: Damac Properties
description: With a track record of delivering over 27,000 homes in two decades, DAMAC Properties stands firm in the Middle East real estate market. Hussain Sajwani, founder of DAMAC Group, established the property development company in 2002, and since then, they have designed projects showcasing their commitment to innovation and distinctive designs. The meticulous attention to detail, premium finishes and state-of-the-art amenities distinguish DAMAC Properties from its competition. One of its notable developments is Dubai Hills, a golf community in Dubai that houses luxury apartments and villas.

name: Sobha Realty
description: Established in India in 1995, Sobha Properties Dubai is the name behind numerous residential and commercial projects in Dubai. The luxury property development company is renowned for its dedication to crafting meticulously designed apartments and villas that foster a lifestyle characterized by luxury and tranquility. Sobha Properties prioritizes upholding the highest quality standards throughout every development phase.  Creek Vistas Reserve, Gardenia Villas, Forest Villas, One Park Avenue and Hartland Greens Apartment are some of the most prominent developments in the city's top area.

name: Binghatti
description: Under the leadership of CEO and Head of Architecture, Mr. Muhammad BinGhatti, Binghatti Developers has played a crucial role in changing the Dubai real estate market dynamics. Since 2008, Binghatti Dubai has earned a distinguished reputation in the MENA region, delivering an unmatched living experience and establishing itself as a leader in the industry. Every project of the preeminent Emirati developer reflects sophistication and innovation, whether in an apartment, a villa or a store. Binghatti Company Dubai has a diverse portfolio of properties in areas like JVC, Business Bay and Downtown Dubai.

name: Ellington Properties
description: Delivery quality projects to clients since 2014, Ellington Properties is one of the most prominent property developers in Dubai. It is known for creating luxury residential and commercial residences emphasizing modern design, quality craftsmanship and a commitment to sustainable practices. Joseph Thomas and Nitin Bhatnagar are the owners of Ellington Dubai, the name behind several award-winning developments in the emirate, including Ellington Beach House and Ocean House in Palm Jumeirah, DT1 in Downtown Dubai, Ellington House in Dubai Hills Estate and  Belgravia, Belgravia II, Belgravia Square and more in JVC.

name: Azizi Developments
description:
Azizi Developments is a leading developer belonging to the AZIZI Group, headquartered in Dubai, UAE. The company was founded in 2007 by Mirwais Azizi, an Afghan entrepreneur, and has been successfully engaged in real estate development since then.
For more than 15 years of activity, Azizi Developments has implemented many projects of various scales and directions, paying special attention to innovative design and high quality. The company is actively building not only in the UAE, but also abroad, including countries such as Canada, Great Britain, Azerbaijan and others.
Azizi Developments has been awarded numerous real estate awards, including the title of "Developer of the Year" three years in a row, which confirms its reputation as one of the leading developers in the region. The company strives to meet the needs of customers by offering a variety of real estate properties, from multifunctional complexes to residential communities, providing comfort and safety for all its customers.
The company's mission is to put customers at the forefront, focusing on the highest level of customer service and satisfaction, honesty and transparency, as well as delivering excellent products that provide high returns/ROI.

name: Meraas
description: Recognized for its impeccable design and superior craftsmanship, Meraas has an impressive portfolio of real estate, hospitality, leisure and entertainment properties. Since 2007, the leading real estate developer in Dubai has worked on several successful projects in the most sought-after locations â€” City Walk, Bluewaters, Jumeira Bay, Pearl Jumeira and La Me. What sets them apart is their high quality, timely delivery, and comprehensive master planning, which is evident in all Meraas Dubai projects. Some of their most popular developments include Outlet Village by Meraas Dubai, Al Seef by Meraas Dubai and Laguna Waterpark by Meraas.

name: Imtiaz Developments
description: Imtiaz Developments, established in 2011, is a Dubai-based real estate developer specializing in luxury residential and commercial properties. The company is known for its high-end projects, such as Imtiaz Tower and Imtiaz Residences, which feature contemporary designs, state-of-the-art amenities, and prime locations. Imtiaz Developments is committed to delivering exceptional quality and value, focusing on customer satisfaction and innovation. The developerâ€™s attention to detail and dedication to excellence has earned it a strong reputation in the competitive Dubai real estate market, making it a preferred choice among investors and homebuyers seeking luxurious living spaces.

name: Aldar Properties
description: Aldar Properties is a reputable real estate development company in the Middle East and North Africa, headquartered in Abu Dhabi. Talal Al Dhiyebi is the CEO of the real estate company that develops commercial and residential properties, hotels, schools, offices, marinas and golf courses. Aldar Development has created several iconic projects, including Yas Island. The company has also received various awards and accolades for its contributions to the real estate industry, recognizing its commitment to excellence in design, sustainability and overall development.

name: Samana Developers
description: Samana Developers is a promising new name in the real estate development market in Dubai. The company is known for developing residential properties, including apartments and other housing solutions. Samana Developers emphasizes innovative design and high-quality construction in its projects to provide residents with modern and comfortable accommodations. Whether you want an ideal luxury home in Jumeirah Village Circle or Dubai Production City, Samana Dubai offers tranquil living spaces that are sustainable, innovative and adaptable.

name: Danube Properties
description: Danube has come a long way, from a humble store in Deira to solidifying its position as the region's most trustworthy brand. The Danube Properties' head office is in Dubai â€“ however, the company operates all around the UAE, KSA, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, India and Africa. Danube Properties Development is known for delivering exceptional quality and ensuring client satisfaction. Whether it is the transformable apartments of Starz by Danube or the thriving gated community of Petalz by Danube, you'll notice two things in common in all their projects â€” convenience and innovation.

name: Nakheel
description: Nakheel Properties is a globally acclaimed developer dedicated to creating communities that foster urban living. Their projects, positioned in Dubai's highly sought-after neighborhoods, showcase innovation and sophistication. One of Nakheel's flagship achievements is its iconic waterfront initiatives, which have recognized it as one of the top real estate developers in Dubai. With the development of Palm Jumeirah, Nakheel Properties Dubai has notably extended the cityâ€™s coastline by over 300 kilometers, setting new standards for the real estate industry.

name: Arada Properties
description: Arada Properties is a fast-growing real estate developer based in Sharjah, UAE, founded in 2017. The company has quickly become one of the leading developers in the emirate, with a focus on creating integrated communities that offer a mix of residential, commercial, and leisure facilities. Arada's flagship projects include Aljada, Sharjah's largest-ever mixed-use community, and Nasma Residences, a family-friendly residential community. These developments are designed to meet the needs of modern living, with features such as smart home technology, extensive green spaces, and a wide range of amenities. Arada's commitment to quality and innovation has made it a key player in the UAE's real estate market.

name: Object 1
description: Object One Real Estate Development is a leading real estate developer in Dubai, known for its innovative approach and dedication to excellence. As part of the TSZ Group, which has been active in the real estate market since 2010, Object 1 has seen its development volume increase tremendously over the past few years. Some of the premier Object One Real Estate projects in Dubai for sale include W1nner Tower, Ozone1 Residence, 1Wood Residence, and V1ter. Their strategically located developments offer residents and businesses unmatched convenience and access to Dubai's dynamic lifestyle.

name: Omniyat
description: The unique masterpieces and destinations crafted by Omniyat are the symbols of luxury and creativity. The brand consistently challenges the norms of architecture, constructing residential, commercial, hospitality, and retail spaces that contribute to the ever-evolving silhouette of Dubai's skyline. Established by Mahdi Amjad in 2005, Omniyat, under his leadership, has marked its name among the top property developers in Dubai. Focusing on art and design, the brand has forged collaborations with industry luminaries such as Zaha Hadid and Norman Foster, creating iconic architectural marvels that transcend conventional boundaries.

name: Nshama
description: Nshama Dubai creates homes that make you feel connected. Understanding the needs of homebuyers and investors with diverse tastes and preferences, they are indeed the "local experts" of the Dubai real estate market. Nshama Development has designed the master community Town Square in Dubailand, offering the best facilities and convenience. Ayala, Symphony, Aria, The Diplomat Residences and Ascot Residences are some of their top projects with modern layouts and lifestyle amenities like swimming pools, kidsâ€™ play areas and lush green spaces.

name: Reportage Properties
description: Reportage Properties, established in 2014, is a leading real estate developer in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, known for its high-quality residential and commercial projects. The companyâ€™s notable developments include Reportage Village and Reportage Tower, both of which offer modern designs, premium amenities, and strategic locations. Reportage Properties is committed to delivering value-driven properties that cater to the needs of investors and end-users alike, ensuring that each project meets the highest standards of quality and sustainability. The developerâ€™s focus on customer satisfaction and innovation has quickly earned it a strong reputation in the UAE real estate market.

name: Tiger Group
description: Since 1976, Tiger Group has overseen significant projects for a diverse client base. Operating across the Gulf, Turkey, and the Middle East, Tiger Group is positioned as one of the top real estate developers in Dubai. The company has expanded its scope beyond project construction and real estate development to encompass facilities management, education, manufacturing and healthcare. Under the guidance of Chairman Waleed Mohammad AlZoubi, Tiger Group Dubai has synergized efforts to achieve its core mission, which is to make significant contributions to the country's economic development.

name: Beyond
description: Established by the Omniyat Group, BEYOND is redefining the boundaries of luxury and innovation in the premium real estate market. With a strong foundation in sustainability, cutting-edge design, and lush green landscapes, BEYOND creates developments that harmoniously blend modern elegance with natural beauty. Its debut project, SARIA, exemplifies this commitment, offering residences that seamlessly unite comfort, sophistication, and an organic connection to their surroundings. Under the visionary leadership of Mahdi Amjad, Founder and Executive Chairman of Omniyat Group, BEYOND is setting new benchmarks in the industry.

name: Select Group
description: Select Group is a versatile and forward-thinking company regarded as one of the top real estate property developers in Dubai. They offer an array of off-plan and move-in-ready properties in the city's prime locations and are experts in construction, operation and management. One of the best real estate companies in Dubai, Select caters to a diverse clientele across the United Arab Emirates, Europe and the United Kingdom. Select Group is committed to providing the best design and quality while delivering unparalleled living experiences. Jumeirah Living Business Bay and Nautica One & Nautica Two are some of their most  prominent projects.

name: Majid Al Futtaim
description: Established in 1992, Majid Al Futtaim is a family-owned conglomerate that has emerged as a trailblazer in developing shopping malls, communities, retail and leisure destinations. Operating across diverse sectors, Majid Al Futtaim is considered one of the top property developers in Dubai. The group unveiled its multifaceted community in Dubai, Tilal Al Ghaf, which offers upscale apartments, contemporary villas, and townhouses. This project epitomizes sophistication and is a testament to Majid Al Futtaim's commitment to crafting exceptional living spaces in the heart of Dubai.

name: H&H Development
description: The Dubai-based real estate company, H & H Development, offers an array of services, from development and property management to home decor. Shahab Lutfi Harmoozi and Mohamed Al Hussaini are the founders of the company, which has a diverse profile, including mixed-use properties, residential developments, and hospitality and retail projects. Some of the top projects of H &H, one of the best real estate developers in Dubai, are Eden House the Canal, Eden House Al Satwa, Galleria Villa, Al Wasl, and Tower-O14 Business Bay.

name: MAG Group
description: Established 40 years ago, Moafaq Ahmad Al Gaddah Group is a prominent player in contracting, engineering, freight services, hospitality, and industrial and commercial trading. Based in the UAE, MAG Property Development is one of the divisions of the multinational conglomerate promoting a wellness-oriented living concept in the region. MAG Dubai is actively involved in diverse ventures, ranging from upscale properties to affordable housing options. MAG City (also known as MAG Eye), MAG 214, MAG 218, and Emirates Towers are some of the top projects of the MAG Group of Companies.

name: Dubai Properties
description: Dubai Properties has developed some of the cityâ€™s most celebrated and iconic real estate destinations that offer distinctive and enriching lifestyles to residents. Boasting over 18 years of expertise in the residential property sector that started in 2002, Dubai Properties delivers innovative lifestyle solutions. Khalid Al Malik is the CEO of Dubai Properties, one of the top real estate property developers in Dubai. The extensive portfolio of Dubai Properties extends across the Emirate, encompassing renowned areas such as Business Bay, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), Business Bay, Dubailand and Jaddaf Waterfront.
